name: Montenegro Spritz
instructions:
1. Fill a wine glass with ice.
2. Add the remaining ingredients.
3. Stir to combine.
description: The Montenegro Spritz is a refreshing twist on the classic Italian spritz, blending bold bitterness with effervescent brightness. This cocktail features Amaro Montenegro, a rich, cherry-and-spice-infused amaro, balanced by crisp Prosecco and a touch of soda water. The deep, complex flavors of the amaro—highlighting notes of orange, coriander, and clove—are softened by the light, fruity bubbles of the wine, creating a sophisticated yet easy-to-make drink. A sprig of sage adds an earthy aroma, elevating the experience beyond a simple spritz. Perfect for summer sipping, it’s a deeper, more nuanced alternative to the traditional Aperol Spritz, offering layers of flavor that unfold with each sip.
garnish: Sprig of sage, half of an orange wheel, dehydrated grapefruit wheel
